title: Polish Tofu Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful dish that combines the best of Polish and Asian cuisines. Tofu is marinated in a mixture of Polish spices and herbs, then pan-fried and served in a bowl over a bed of wholesome goodness.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Polish Sausage Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Available in most supermarkets or online

instructions: Cut the tofu into bite-sized pieces and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the tofu with a little bit of oil and sprinkle with Polish sausage seasoning. Toss to coat.
Roast the tofu in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
While the tofu is roasting, slice the bitter melon into thin rounds.
Heat a little bit of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced bitter melon to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and lightly browned.
Cut the whole wheat bread into 1-inch cubes and toast until lightly browned.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of the roasted tofu on the bottom, followed by a few slices of bitter melon, some toasted bread cubes, and finally a sprinkle of Polish sausage seasoning.
